"""Heavy-input sizing: big payloads, many targets, zstd transport, subprocess."""
import base64, gc, json, os, resource, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
import io, random
import ipaddress, zstandard as zstd
from common import COLUMNS
from gen_targets import plan as plan_targets

def big_payload_case(nrecords=20000, size=5000, encoding='csv'):
    rnd = random.Random(11)
    leases = [{'id': 'L%d' % i, 'prefix': '2001:db8:%x::/56' % i, 'start': 0, 'end': 1000,
               'subnets': [0, 1], 'low_count': 4} for i in range(8)]
    services = [{'id': 'adb0', 'kind': 'adb'}]
    ctx = {l['id']: {**l, 'network': ipaddress.IPv6Network(l['prefix']), 'subnets': l['subnets']} for l in leases}
    manifest, lookup, lows = plan_targets(ctx, 'demo')
    probes = [(k, v) for k, v in lookup.items()]
    buf = io.StringIO()
    buf.write(','.join(COLUMNS) + '\n')
    for i in range(nrecords):
        (lease, probe), (target, canary) = probes[rnd.randrange(len(probes))]
        t = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(target))
        payload = base64.b64encode(bytes(rnd.randrange(256) for _ in range(size))).decode()
        buf.write('app,p%06d,%d,%d,put,%s,%d,,%s,,open,adb0,%d,%s\n' % (
            i, rnd.randrange(3), rnd.randrange(1000), lease, rnd.randrange(1000), t, i % 4, payload))
    data = buf.getvalue().encode()
    if encoding == 'zstd':
        data = zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=1).compress(data)
    chunks = [base64.b64encode(data[i:i + 1 << 20]).decode() for i in range(0, len(data), 1 << 20)]
    return {'version': 3, 'seed': 'demo', 'leases': leases, 'services': services, 'queries': [10, 999],
            'captures': [{'encoding': encoding, 'chunks': chunks}], 'requests': [], 'offers': [],
            'request_quotas': [{'id': 'all', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 4096}],
            'offer_quotas': [{'id': 'all', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 4096}]}

def many_targets_case():
    leases = [{'id': 'L%04d' % i, 'prefix': '2001:db8:%x::/56' % i, 'start': 0, 'end': 1000,
               'subnets': list(range(16)), 'low_count': 32} for i in range(124)]
    return {'version': 3, 'seed': 'demo', 'leases': leases, 'services': [{'id': 's', 'kind': 'tcp'}],
            'queries': [1, 2, 3, 4], 'captures': [], 'requests': [], 'offers': [],
            'request_quotas': [], 'offer_quotas': []}

def report(label, job, subprocess_mode=False):
    raw = json.dumps(job).encode()
    t = time.time()
    if subprocess_mode:
        work = '/workspace/tmp/heavy'
        os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
        env = dict(os.environ, TMPDIR=work, PYTHONHASHSEED='0')
        proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],
                              input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                              cwd=work, env=env)
        assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr[-2000:]
        out = proc.stdout
        res = json.loads(out)
        size = len(out)
    else:
        import campaign
        gc.disable()
        res = campaign.audit(campaign.parse_json(raw))
        gc.enable()
        size = len(json.dumps(res, separators=(',', ':')))
    print('%-28s input %.1f MiB  audit %.1fs  output %.1f MiB  maxrss %.0f MiB  manifest %d rejected %d' % (
        label, len(raw)/1048576, time.time()-t, size/1048576,
        resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024, len(res['manifest']), len(res['rejected'])))
    return res

if __name__ == '__main__':
    which = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'all'
    if which in ('all', 'targets'):
        res = report('many targets (in-proc)', many_targets_case())
        assert len(res['manifest']) == 124*16*33
        assert len(res['snapshots']) == 4
    if which in ('all', 'payload'):
        report('big adb payloads csv', big_payload_case(20000, 5000, 'csv'))
    if which in ('all', 'zstd'):
        report('big adb payloads zstd', big_payload_case(20000, 5000, 'zstd'))
    if which in ('all', 'sub'):
        report('many targets (subprocess)', many_targets_case(), subprocess_mode=True)
PYEOF
